authority.note: Observation end conditions only; not validated profit parameters; never written back into the original confirmation result

strong.end_when: arrangement breaks; any equality counts as break

medium.note: independent profile; must NOT be judged with the strong condition and must NOT impersonate strong

weak_scope.definition: weak label = EMA7<EMA25 AND close>EMA99 (scanner.py:199-200 ignitionGrade 'weak', riskFlag 弱穿线)
weak_scope.mapping: keeps its original label only; tracking_profile = null
weak_scope.legacy_weak_ema99_cross_technical_id: ema_observations bind_identity kind weak_ema99_cross exists but is OUT of v1 tracking scope (no event_kind in schema)
weak_scope.note: 1017 selected only strong and independent medium observation; a weak hint is never promoted to a medium/strong confirmation

A.candidate_independent: A technical tracking identity does not depend on a candidate cycle; candidate expired_30d/new_lows/oi_contraction keep their original qualification result and do not end technical observation

B.start: technical h pass (technical_event == pass) may start observation; confirm_failed stays trackable without rewrite; structure fail -> technical_observation_only
B.end_when: a later closed 4H with EMA7 <= EMA25 (equality ends)
B.identity: session uses the ORIGINAL B event_id (bev-…); tracking profile identity stored separately in session.tracking_profile_id/version

rearm.s0_risk_line: fixed S0 = EMA99 of the 4H bound to confirmation; close < S0 -> risk alert only

waiting.behaviour: observe while the original cycle runs; evidence gaps pause only the affected judgement

invalidated.behaviour: END the observation of that cycle (end_reason cycle_invalidated); a new cycle needs the original rearm; never reopen the same event

expired.behaviour: keep original cycle state 'expired' (fact retained); MAY continue technical observation with fixed T0 real low; end when a later closed 4H close < T0 low (strict); post-window volume = progress only, never back-fills C1

confirmed.behaviour: ONLY the independent post-confirm profile applies: cycle_low = min(low of all real closed 4H T0..C1); end when a later close < cycle_low (strict; equal does not end); missing bar in T0..C1 -> reference unknown -> paused; waiting-phase rules (adjacent LSR>=1.5, new lows) are NOT applied after confirm (risk note only)

C.authority_note: 1017 §4.2 uses 收盘严格跌破 (close), not low

missing_data.action: pause ONLY the evidence-dependent judgement (structure end checks, confirm checks) and backfill
missing_data.never: judge a structure break or stitch continuity across a gap
missing_data.c_lifetime_rule: C waiting lifetime ends at the real T+10 close boundary regardless of gaps; expiry is recorded with partially_unverified + missing reasons

human_stop.independent_of_market_data_completeness: (S1-R1-P2-02) an explicit human stop at boundary B (stop_at_open_ms) is evaluated BEFORE any evidence-dependent early return: a missing reference low, missing/incomplete after-bars, missing close, unknown EMA or empty after_bars never turn it into paused_awaiting_data and never lose end_reason=human_stop. Applies to A, B and C observation.
human_stop.precedence_vs_natural_end: an earlier PROVABLE natural end (structure_invalid at a bar open < B, continuity intact) keeps its own reason and time; the human stop is retained as a control fact (human_stop_at_open_ms) and never reopens. Otherwise ended/human_stop at B with natural_end_unverified=true when the bars before B could not be fully evaluated (gap_from_open_ms keeps the first hole). A later backfill that proves an earlier natural end appends a historical revision; it never revives the session. A cycle_invalidated end is not rewritten by a later stop.
human_stop.new_trigger: a genuinely new trigger creates a new event identity
